newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FPHC, Anscor in talks on land venture.
newsitem.headline: FPHC, Anscor in talks on land venture.

text.p: The provincial government of Guimaras said on Thursday it was negotiating with First Philippine Holdings Corp and A Soriano Corp to jointly develop a 216.49 hectare site into a special economic zone.

In an application submitted to the Philippine Economic Zone Authority, the government said it was planning to develop public land on the central Philippine island into an industrial zone at a cost of 1.7 billion pesos.
Light to medium industries needed for the processing of agricultural products and electronics components were expected to be set up, the documant said.
Approval from the Philippine Economic Zone Authority will allow developers to enjoy tax and tariff incentives.
